text:
دھوبیا دے گھر ڈھکے چور۔
او نہ لٹّے، لٹّے ہور۔
romanized:
Dhobīā de ghar dhukke chor.
O na luṭṭe, luṭṭe hor.
literal_en:
If a thief get into a washerman's house,
it is not the washerman who is robbed, but others.
meaning_en: (whose clothes are with him to wash)

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
